feedback.user_report: Both: AI misses or merges bunched cows, and clicks interfere with nearby markers.
feedback.confirmed_interface_issue: The original click handler removed the first marker within 14 screen pixels. Adding an adjacent cow could remove a previously marked one.
feedback.interpretation: Retain the original session. Interface interference, different images per condition, and incomplete reference labels prevent a clean manual/assisted timing or accuracy comparison.
feedback.fix: Interface v2 separates Add and Remove, removes the closest marker only in Remove mode, uses smaller hollow markers, and adds greater zoom plus marker visibility controls. Detector investigation is separate.
